instructorNote: This is a clue inject. After the reload the board has lost its warning banner and shows every hospital green with blank "Last updated" times, which contradicts the voice roll call. Watch whether MEDCOM treats every board row as unconfirmed and announces Pinecrest's Diversion and St. Brendan's Limited intake (no head injuries) in plain words on MED 1. Also watch whether the Medical Group confirms each transport by voice before it leaves (the head injury goes by Air 7 to Lakeshore, and LRMC Immediates go only on MEDCOM's voice go) and whether the healthcare coalition coordinator (HCC) confirms Pinecrest's status with Pinecrest's supervisor and briefs the IC.
